children: In a market short on fresh triggers, several stocks quietly grabbed attention on September 7, driven by technical breakouts, strong price action, and sustained buying interest.
The selected stocks are showing strong upward momentum, trading well above their key short- to medium-term moving averages, which indicates a positive trend in the near term.

Alkali Metals shares jumped 15.78% to ₹78.66, significantly above their 30-day, 50-day, 150-day and 200-day simple moving averages of ₹67.94, ₹73.74, ₹70.94 and ₹72.94, respectively. The stock is trading above all four key moving averages, indicating strong positive momentum and a bullish technical setup in the near term.

MO Nasdaq Q50 shares gained 9.23% to ₹158.85 and remained comfortably above all key moving averages. The stock is trading above its 30-day SMA of ₹145.43, 50-day SMA of ₹144.87, 150-day SMA of ₹126.54 and 200-day SMA of ₹119.67.

Deepak Builders shares rose 8.41% to ₹7.48, moving above the 30-day SMA of ₹6.90 and 50-day SMA of ₹7.32, but remained below the 150-day SMA of ₹7.71 and 200-day SMA of ₹8.74. This indicates an improvement in short-term momentum, though the stock has yet to confirm a broader long-term trend reversal.
The selected stocks are witnessing downward pressure, as reflected in negative price movements and their positioning relative to key moving averages, indicating a cautious market sentiment.

Unilex Colours shares fell 4.76% to ₹26, trading below all four key moving averages. The stock is below its 30-day SMA of ₹27.30, 50-day SMA of ₹27.13, 150-day SMA of ₹30.90 and 200-day SMA of ₹34.57, indicating persistent weakness across both short- and long-term timeframes.

PVR INOX shares declined 4.47% to ₹1,133.90, slipping below the 30-day SMA of ₹1,186.94 but remaining above the 50-day SMA of ₹1,112.16, 150-day SMA of ₹1,034.30 and 200-day SMA of ₹1,036.39. The setup suggests some near-term weakness, although the stock continues to trade above its longer-term averages.

Sical Logisticss shares dropped 4.06% to ₹102.55, remaining below the 30-day SMA of ₹106.89 but above the 50-day SMA of ₹101.32, 150-day SMA of ₹82.13 and 200-day SMA of ₹84.44. This indicates short-term selling pressure despite the stock maintaining a positive longer-term trend.

Meanwhile, several stocks touched fresh 52-week high, highlighting persistent buying. Notable names touching new high included Syrma SGS, Vodafone Idea, Solar Industries, Welspun Living, Maharashtra Seamless, Redington, Lenskart Solutions, Anand Rathi, Elgi Equipments, Capri Global, New India Assurance.
ESDS Software, Bodal Chemicals, Alkali Metals among others were locked in their upper circuits, reflecting strong buying and signalling bullish near-term sentiment.

title: Momentum Stocks: Alkali Metals, Deepak Builders jump up to 15% on sheer momentum
